name: visual-axis-defaults
citation: Intended source: Polans J, Jaeken B, McNabb RP, Artal P, Izatt JA. Wide-field optical model of the human eye with asymmetrically tilted and decentered lens that reproduces measured ocular aberrations. Optica 2(2):124-134, 2015 (doi 10.1364/OPTICA.2.000124), not reachable from the cloud session (2026-10-28). Values here are the typical magnitude quoted by search excerpts (angle alpha about 5°, visual axis nasal of the optical axis in object space; teaching summaries give 3–5°).
alphaNote: Horizontal only, positive nasal: the fixation target lies nasal of the optical axis and the fovea temporal. Same value in the right- and left-eye documents (local frames have x temporal).
kappaNote: Required by the schema; taken equal to alpha (an assumption). Nothing in M3 reads it.
pupilDecenterNote: Assumption: a centered pupil until Polans 2015 (or another source) is transcribed.
